name: waterdeep-passage
note: Fresh un-scarred Corvin (built from Wipe). Player negotiates smuggled passage to Waterdeep WITHOUT their name on the manifest, to hunt someone who wronged them years ago. Corvin warms from cool-professional to complicit partner; forms suspicion-then-alliance beliefs; trust climbs to ~0.70. Great showcase of relationship-conditioned recall + emergent belief formation + the live in-browser brain panel. THIS is the reference direction to emulate before any pivot.
